fireside.speaker: A man, maybe 40s, with a long braid
fireside.text: "Stone. We need 58 more for the palisade footings. Creek beds, hillsides — pry it loose."

fireside.speaker: Catalina
fireside.text: "Stone. We need 52 more for the palisade footings. Creek beds, hillsides — pry it loose."

fireside.speaker: Gerhard
fireside.text: "134 wood. We need 350. The forest isn't going to cut itself."

fireside.speaker: Manuel
fireside.text: "The table's set. The ring of pale light — it's just sitting there. Waiting on them. What do you think they'll tell it?"

fireside.speaker: Catalina
fireside.text: "Why them? ...Sorry. It's just sitting there, and they're the one who has to sit in it."

tableLines.line: SYSTEM: Neural interface stable. Text overlay enabled.
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Catalina speaks at Emberhold's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"
You don't know what that was. An inflatable rat the size of a house. Someone at the haven should hear about this.

The warm hum behind your ribs is gone. The reactor went with Catalina's body — it does not come out, and it does not pass on. Hunger is back on the table. (One reactor per world, and the world already spent its one.)
◈ THE TABLE IS SET. A ring of pale light waits — take your seat from Haven when you are ready. Nothing is final until you sit.

💛 You hold Daughter's Drawing. Kitchen table, burnt pancakes. You told her the sun needed holding, and she took you literally — drew you carrying it with both hands. She was six. The sky changed three weeks later. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, and they are still yours. The feast was the weapon.
